query.text: 请帮我看着厨房里烧着的锅，如果我走开了或者有危险请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the pot cooking on the stove in the kitchen, and alert me promptly if I walk away or if there is any danger.

annotation.text_zh: 锅还烧着呢，别忘了关火。
annotation.text_en: The stove is still on, don't forget to turn it off.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
